portInfo.description: The Virgin Islands Port Authority operates the Ann E. Abramson Marine Facility as St. Croix’s sole cruise gateway in Frederiksted. VIPA states the pier is 1,526 feet long with 29-foot north and 36-foot south drafts, that the south berth can accommodate Voyager-class ships while the north takes smaller cruise ships, and that larger vessels may use outer-harbor anchorage arranged through DPNR. The waterfront park/pier revitalization history (Hugo 1989 damage; cruise opening 1994; Marilyn 1995; early-2000s rebuild; naming via Act No. 6041) is on the same VIPA page.
